gen-dafont-capture-smallz-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab feels structured and precise, its slab-serif middle zone dominating every line with open-throated a and s. And with Capture Smallz raw and tactical above, text below would move steadily, line after line.
gen-dafont-college-bitter: Chunky, confident curves: College makes every bend match its straight stems in weight, with big counters. Bitter, a dependable slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye, keeps its footing if College gets made small.
gen-dafont-college-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, with generous space between its curve ends and stems. But College does its loudest work with strokes that look marker-traced, and the sans does its finest work in the details.
gen-dafont-college-gf-epunda-slab: Dignified is the first word for Epunda Slab, whose gaping c and rounded forms look settled next to College. What stands out is the stem-thick curves against that open, rounded text.
gen-dafont-college-gf-fauna-one: One thick thread looped into letters: that is College, big counters and all. And Fauna One, a literary serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, takes over the quieter work.
gen-dafont-college-gf-glegoo: Glegoo is refined and editorial, its curved letters left wide and unclosed at the mouth. And the pair's backbone is College, whose strokes never swell in the bowls, against that open text.
gen-dafont-college-gf-hanuman: College bends each letter as though from one length of tubing, with generous counters. Hanuman then adds a traditional, refined voice, its high-waisted lowercase and wide-set s terminals settling things down.
gen-dafont-college-gf-kadwa: Drafting-pen outlines from a nib that never changes width: that is the whole look of College. And it earns its keep big and short, while Kadwa, a serif with open-ended curves, carries the rest.
gen-dafont-college-gf-pridi: Round letters like bent wire, big counters and all: that is College. And Pridi, a refined serif with small letters standing proud, almost capital-sized, holds its ground if College gets made small.
gen-dafont-college-gf-scope-one: Scope One is traditional and refined, with stubby ascenders and descenders. The pair's real hook is a body whose counters spill into the surrounding space against College, where every stroke keeps one gauge.
